data_source: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily prices; identical 60/40 engine, hedge and ranking settings

methodology.asia_two_slots: Asia 15% sleeve split equally between rank 1 and rank 2 (7.5% each); other three equity sleeves remain 15%; hedge remains 40%.
methodology.greece_exclusion: Compare EGPT/GREK/TUR against EGPT/TUR; the fourth sleeve remains 15%, with no forced replacement weight or change to other sleeves.
methodology.coverage: Strict complete coverage for every selected equity and both hedge assets; compare each pair on exact common holding months.
methodology.limitations: Exploratory model, not an official Logical Invest replication. No fees, taxes, FX or slippage. Excluding GREK tests its contribution to selection, not a synthetic cap on its underlying constituents.
